newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Following weekly movement of 113,500.
The last established price was $61.00-$62.00 per cwt on Thursday. Friday's packer bids were $62.00, with asking prices $63.00-$64.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
